capture.source: live #jgbox from each Demonstration metadata route
capture.scene: fresh browser context with empty local/session storage; exact route without query; route default preset; capture-time board resize, axes/grid visibility, and bounding box only
capture.geometricRoutes: hide default axes, ticks, and grid
capture.coordinateContext: retain default axes, ticks, and grid for Bernstein and function demonstrations
capture.scalePolicy: equal user-unit scale to preserve geometric proportions
capture.typography: capture-only 11px JSXGraph text and rational smart-label font; source content unchanged
capture.containment: finite construction objects and their text annotations stay within the board; axis/tick labels are context; unbounded coordinate-route curves are viewport-clipped by JSXGraph
capture.boundsPolicy: finite visible objects and point coordinates; excludes axes, ticks, and grid; up to three text-aware refits; coordinate-route curves may extend beyond the viewport
